comparison: Same baseline plus one temperature feature per experiment; fixed params, splits, targets, masks and runtime versions
current_definition: Reanalysis temperature for D-1 11:00 Europe/Brussels, source hour ending at the D-1 noon origin, frozen for all D hours; publication vintages unverified

partner_reference.availability_correction: Earlier commentary was too conservative about price_lag24. Future delivery/valid time does not imply future availability for day-ahead auction prices or forecasts. This experiment still uses the original weekly-only baseline to isolate temperature. Exact elapsed 24h lags also need a fall-DST guard: the last hour of a 25-hour day can reference a price from the same delivery day, which would not be published by the previous noon. One such France validation hour is present.
partner_reference.comparison: Different feature set, loss/target transform, source table and aggregate country coverage; per-France score not reported

delivery_clock_check_not_publication_aud.note: This counts delivery intervals after the origin, not publication times. It does not establish unavailable price information: prices for D-1 are normally auctioned/published on D-2. Historical revision vintages remain unverified. Realised weather_lag24 after the origin is a separate timing concern.
delivery_clock_check_not_publication_aud.scope: France validation timestamps only; no test targets examined

partner_reference.objective: reg:absoluteerror on asinh(price/50); default early stopping on transformed-target error

perfect_definition: Actual/reanalysis temperature at target delivery hour; explicit future-weather oracle diagnostic
weather_archive: PECD/ERA5 population-weighted temperature in Celsius; no archived weather forecasts were fetched
